title: R-201 豁免名單改用 NOT IN 子查詢
description: 將豁免帳戶判斷由 NOT EXISTS 改寫為 NOT IN,語意等價。

files.diff:
@@ -9 +9 @@
-  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exempt_accounts e WHERE e.account_id = t.account_id)
+  AND t.account_id NOT IN (SELECT e.account_id FROM exempt_accounts e)
files.full_content:
-- R-201: 單日 ATM 現金提領累計達 100000(含)通報
SELECT
    t.account_id,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.tx_type = 'WITHDRAW'
  AND t.channel = 'ATM'
  AND t.currency = 'TWD'
  AND t.tx_time >= :start_date AND t.tx_time < :end_date
  AND t.account_id NOT IN (SELECT e.account_id FROM exempt_accounts e)
GROUP BY t.account_id
HAVING SUM(t.amount) >= 100000;

_golden.intent: R003:NOT IN + 子查詢,豁免名單含 NULL 時整個條件不成立,規則會靜默失效 → major。描述宣稱「語意等價」是錯的。
